text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I came to watch Fenomeno's 
dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Ha! How about that!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Perfect timing. If you don't 
mind, I'd like your opinion too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... How was that?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, the movement itself isn't a problem, 
but...
choice_data_list: Maybe my face looks a little scary...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! To think even my dancing 
scares people...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Am I being too tense...? Urgh, I despise 
my own clumsiness...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, it's fortunate that 
we identified the problem."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"A natural expression... It is a bit of a 
challenge, but by no means an unsolvable 
problem!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot do it, then all I must do is 
put in the effort until I can!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hard work... I think that sounds great. I 
wanna help out with something too, osu...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure, sir?
choice_data_list: Then I've got to lend a hand too.
Then I have to lend a hand too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much! Now then, let us 
first decide on our plan going forward.
choice_data_list:
Let's just get through as many reps as we 
can!

Why don't we raise the dance level even 
higher?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A simple and clear approach really is the 
most effective!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes... Nothing beats hard work, after all!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Though running and dancing may differ, the 
importance of repetition and consistency 
remains the same, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it. As many times as it takes 
until you make a natural expression!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with countless practice 
sessions, she significantly improved the 
quality of her dance.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I see... Overwhelm them with your dancing 
so they won't even notice your facial 
expression, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see... That might be an even harder path 
than putting effort into making facial 
expressions...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However! Overcoming a massive wall should 
serve as a wonderful example to others!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely what this officer 
desires as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Without fail, we shall accomplish this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, throwing herself into practice, 
she improved the quality of her dance 
significantly.
